children: A trader with losses of more than $620,000 bought $77,000 worth of G2 to beat 9Z in the CS2 FISSURE Playground loser-bracket matchup, with an average entry price of 71.8 cents and 108,304.8 shares purchased. According to Odaily, the match began at 11:00 on September 10 as a BO3 semifinal in the lower half of Group A, where the loser was eliminated and the winner advanced in the race for a playoff spot.

title: Trader Buys $77,000 in G2 to Beat 9Z in CS2 FISSURE Playground Prediction Market
